stem: Before the first move, a path has no initial entry cost and g is the sum of costs of moves already taken. With h(start)=4.8, what are g(start) and f(start)=g+h?
assumptions: No move has yet occurred and there is no separate start-entry charge.
Use the explicitly stated accumulated-move-cost definition, not the contradictory g=1.0 label on page 1135.

citations.locator: Physical PDF page 1133, printed footer 7: Accumulated-move-cost definition and green start cell labeled 0.0.
Physical PDF page 1135, printed footer 9: Green start cell labeled g=1.0, h=4.8, and f=g+h equation; conflicting g label retained as source evidence.
